verdict.rationale: Both diffs make the same correct change to `src/import.ts`: a Map from normalized email to its first index, with appended rows added to the map. This turns the O(n·m) scan into O(n+m) and keeps first-entry-wins and in-upload merging. A also adds a regression test for first-entry-wins, the behavior the index could most easily break, plus a short comment explaining why. B relies only on a throwaway equivalence script that is not committed and so leaves the subtle behavior unguarded.
